eval_cases.description: Field recovery protocol for ERR-PAY-4001 contactless payment freeze with double-charge protection

parts.text: What is the immediate field recovery protocol when a cashier encounters an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze, and how do we ensure the customer is not double-charged?

For an ERR-PAY-4001 contactless payment freeze on Toshiba TCx 810 terminals: 1. Perform an immediate soft-reset via the hardware keypad override or power cycle the terminal. 2. Verify the terminal electronic journal and transaction buffer prior to initiating a second tap to ensure no authorization was captured, preventing double-charging. 3. Refer to the certified POS hardware manual and escalation protocol.

eval_cases.description: Certified recovery steps for receipt printer paper cutter lock error ERR-PRN-2002

parts.text: A receipt printer on Lane 3 has a paper cutter lock error ERR-PRN-2002. What are the certified recovery steps?

To clear ERR-PRN-2002 cutter lock: 1. Power off the printer. 2. Open the front cutter access door and manually rotate the knurled cutter gear until the blade retracts to home position. 3. Clear jammed paper fragments, close the cover firmly, power on, and execute a self-test print.
